description: The size of a family of nonempty pairwise disjoint subsets is at most the size of their union.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.disjoint_nonempty_cardinality.{u} {α ι : Type u} (P : ι → Set α)
  (hn : ∀ (i : ι), (P i).Nonempty) (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)) :
  Cardinal.mk ι ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑(⋃ i, P i)
